SYNTHETIC STDERR (Phase 5 plan 01, explicitly blocked) — not captured from a real gemini-cli run.

Blocker: no free-tier GEMINI_API_KEY available for 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED capture.
  - Host OAuth quota is generous and does not trigger 429 under rapid-fire requests
    (10+ parallel attempts).
  - No quota-capped key on hand to force a real rate-limit.

A real rate-limit failure would produce stderr output similar to:

  Error: You have exceeded your quota. Please try again later. [HTTP 429]
  Status: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED

Real-capture deferred to a follow-up gap-closure phase
(resolution_phase: follow-up-quota-capped-key).

retryAfter field: NOT OBSERVED (real 429 response not captured). ErrorMapper must
tolerate absence of retryAfter / retry_after / retryDelay / retry_delay_ms fields.
